spec_config.description: Same as pooled but media effect size partially pooled across geos (non-centred log-normal).

column_definitions.roi_*: total incremental revenue over the period (zero-spend counterfactual, incl. adstock carryover) / total spend
column_definitions.mroi_*: incremental revenue from the next 1% of spend / that 1% of spend, at the observed spend pattern
column_definitions.contribution_*: incremental revenue attributed to the channel over the full period
column_definitions.prob_roi_gt_1: posterior probability the channel returns more revenue than it costs
column_definitions.*_hdi94_*: 94% highest density interval of the posterior
column_definitions.roi_prior_*: same quantity under the prior only; compare with posterior to see how much the data moved it
column_definitions.roi_prior_contraction: 1 - posterior sd / prior sd; near 0 = result is mostly prior
column_definitions.roi_median_{min,max}_across_specs: range of posterior-median ROI over the alternative specifications
column_definitions.roi_median_{min,max}_across_cv_folds: range of posterior-median ROI over rolling-origin CV fits (training windows ending at weeks 104, 117, 130, 143)
column_definitions.channel_gate_status: worst automated-gate status among the checks specific to this channel
